decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf sits close to the core assortment and costs little to keep producing on existing lines, and with only one year of evidence its demand is still uncertain, so the option is worth more than its small carrying cost.

The historic mill tour uses existing heritage facilities and event staff at low marginal cost, its potential to support hospitality and the brand is still unresolved, and the firm holds few comparable experience options, so keeping it preserves upside.

The sweet pastry is cheap to produce on current lines and its value is not yet resolved, but bakeries rotate pastry varieties often, so it carries a somewhat higher drop risk while keeping it still makes sense for now.
